page.layout: One printed page. At the top, a block of inverted (upside-down) text, full width, about 7 lines. Below it, the word FINIS centred. Below that, a printer's ornament (woodcut device) centred. Below the ornament, faint full-width text in about 10 lines, mostly show-through, with a few short lines at the foot. No marginal notes, running head or page number are visible.
page.notes: The top block is printed upside down, so the scan appears inverted at that point; I could not read its words reliably enough to copy them. The lines between FINIS and the ornament, and the faint lines below the ornament, are very faint and mostly show-through from the reverse side, so I could not read them. The ornament is a printer's device, described here only and not transcribed. Because the text is so faint and inverted, this transcription is provisional: a sharper or correctly oriented scan is needed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature could be confidently identified.
